messages:
maria: Quick sync — preflight for AcmeHealth trial. Need final POC acceptance criteria + answers for security questionnaire by EOD Wed. High level goals: latency p95 <= 150ms, cost <= $0.60 per 1k tokens, semantic-quality pass >= 92% on the eval set. Also need VPC/KMS notes for their legal team.
rob: Got it. For the quality metric — is the 92% based on our simi-score threshold or human judgment? Do we have the eval prompts yet?
emily: We're sending them the initial 400 prompts today (mix of clinical Q/A + triage). Human review will be used for final pass but we'll run a simi-score baseline first.
rob: Ok. For latency/cost tradeoff, suggest we run the trial on a quantized Llama-3 13B / batch_size=8 to hit cost targets. If they need stricter latency, swap to 7B or use dedicated capacity.
maria: Noted. They asked for representative traffic: 40 req/s sustained, spikes to 120 req/s for 3-5m. Can Dedicated handle that without autoscale gaps?
sam: Dedicated pool with burst capacity can. We'll config autoscale cooldown to 45s, pre-warm one extra instance at rollout. Need to know memory footprint of the quantized model to size the pool.
rob: Approx mem: q4_0 for 13B ~ 28GB GPU RAM. We'll include a fallback to hosted smaller model for spillover.
emily: On pricing — customer asked for an estimate of monthly burn assuming 40 req/s avg, 50 tokens per response. Can someone run a quick calc?
rob: Rough calc: 40 rps * 3600 * 24 * 30 = 103,680,000 req/mo. At 50 tokens ~ 5.18B tokens/mo. If our target is $0.60 per 1k tokens => ~$3,108/mo. Add overhead for caching/missed KV maybe ~+15% => ~$3.6k/mo. This is for hosted. Dedicated pricing model + reserved capacity will change that.
maria: Good enough for presales. Jess — will you take the security questionnaire items we flagged? They want KMS AES-256, audit logs retention 1 year, and keys rotated every 90 days.
jess: KMS AES-256 is fine. Key rotation 90 days is standard. Audit logs: we store admin/audit logs for 365 days in our enterprise package; need to confirm export ability to their SIEM. Also confirm we can sign BAA addendum — if PHI involved.
maria: PHI likely minimal but must be covered. I'll mark BAA as required.
sam: VPC specifics: we support private-control-plane + customer VPC peering, and optional on-prem connector. For KMS we support Cloud KMS + customer HSM via bring-your-own-key. We'll drop a snippet they can hand to infra:
```
vpc: peering
control_plane: private
kms: BYOK
audit_logs: push-to-s3, retention-days:365
```
rob: For eval harness — here's the command we'll run to generate metrics (quick draft):
```
python eval/run_eval.py --model redwood/llama-13b-q4_0 --prompt-file acme_prompts.json --batch 8 --emit-similarity --out results.csv
```
rob: We'll also surface p95 latency via the console per route and include per-token cost breakdown.
emily: Timeline check: can ENG deliver the quantized 13B build + eval harness by next Tue? We need to ship invites to the customer Wed.
rob: I can have a reproducible build and eval harness by Monday EOD if no blockers. Need access to the prompt set and a short list of fail-cases.
maria: I'll share prompts today. Also raised: legal wants data residency in eu-west-1 for this pilot. Any blockers?
sam: We can run the trial in eu-west-1 hosted region or spin up dedicated capacity there. Need org billing approval for EU capacity; that usually takes 48h to provision.
jess: Confirming: no cross-border data replication for pilot. We'll annotate retention and delete-on-request SLA to 30 days for the trial.
maria: Great. One last item — security questionnaire Q14 asks about incident response contact and SLA. Who should I put?
jess: Put security@redwood-inference.com as primary and me (jess) as backup. Incident SLA: ack within 1h for sev1 during business hours, 15m if we have enterprise on-call.
rob: Small ops note — include a canary route that uses a smaller model for 10% traffic to ensure graceful degradation. Config snippet: `canary: {percent:10, model: llama-7b}`
emily: I'll consolidate all these answers into the presales pack and send to Acme by EOD. Any final blockers?
maria: Ticketing: please open a short ENG task for "Acme trial: build quantized 13B + eval" and tag @rob @sam.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: presales/eval-environment -> eu-west-1 at 2002345688 (prewarm+canary). :rocket:
rob: Thanks. Will update the ticket with perf estimates after first run.
maria: Thanks team — this is the checklist we'll present on the call tomorrow. :thumbsup:
